simple.summary: עֶצֶר (ʻetser) means restraint First listed occurrence: Judg 18 7.

definitions.full: H6114. etser עֶ֫צֶר noun [masculine] restraint (?), only ע ׳יוֺרֵשׁ Judg 18:7 a possessor of restraint , i.e. ruler, but ᵑ9 ᵐ5 wealth , so Thes and others, text very dubious, compare GFM Bu conjecture that ׳ע combines readings אֹצָר and עשֶׁר .
